thread:
Anya: heads up — sampleapp error surface is inconsistent across py/js SDKs. customers keep getting a generic 'ServerError' and it's confusing.

MattG: can you paste snippets? which endpoints are you seeing this on?

Anya: both /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. python client currently returns:
```py
# python sdk
raise ServerError('model crashed')
# shape we get: {'code': 'server_error', 'message': 'internal error'}
```

js client just throws:
```js
// js client
throw new Error('500') // no structured fields, just message
```

This means our retry middleware doesn't catch 429s or transient 502s reliably.

Sarah-L: yikes. We should standardize an error envelope across SDKs. minimal fields: code (enum), http_status, message, hint, retryable (bool), error_id.

Kai: agreed. proposal: top-level: type (enum), http_status, message, retry_hint, transient (bool), error_id. Map 429 -> RATE_LIMIT, 502/503/504 -> TRANSIENT_SERVICE. 5xx that are model internal -> INTERNAL_MODEL (non-retryable).

Anya: also onboarding/sampleapp prints full stack/trace to the UI which scares users. we should have a friendly user-facing message example and a separate "developer view" console output with full trace.

Dev-bot: created issue #4567: "standardize SDK error contract + sampleapp update" — https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/4567 :tada:

MattG: quick checklist for the PRs: update python exceptions module (typed exception classes with attributes), add Error subclass in js with fields, update sampleapp to show both friendly and developer views, add unit tests for mapping 429 -> RetryableError and 502 -> TransientServiceError.

Anya: small UX ask: include a short human_action hint like 'retry in 30s' or 'contact support with error_id' so product teams can show actionable copy.

Sarah-L: +1. also emit error_id and code in telemetry (sampleapp and SDKs) so SREs can correlate traces without exposing PII.

Kai: I'll pick up the python side. will implement typed exceptions and update sampleapp backend logging. @MattG you good to own the js shim? I'll file the issue and assign.

MattG: yep I'll own the js client. will add tests and sampleapp UI bits. target: PRs by EOD PST.

Anya: perfect — thanks all :rocket:
